known_limitations.observation: greedy outputs with taste match the base model
known_limitations.cause: the adapter's tensors use the model.layers.* prefix (base_model.model.model.layers.N.*); this model class (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, weight mapper inherited from Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration) maps only model.language_model.* -> language_model.model.*, so no taste module matches; taiwan and tpu_sft use base_model.model.model.language_model.layers.N.*
known_limitations.effect_on_results: rows that route to taste show the serving cost of an enabled r=128 LoRA slot, not adapter behaviour
resolution: rename the keys to base_model.model.model.language_model.layers.* in adapter_model.safetensors
serve with --hf-overrides '{"architectures": ["Qwen3_5ForCausalLM"]}' (text-only class whose weight mapper accepts both prefixes)

known_limitations.observation: the FP8 checkpoint was measured with --enable-lora only; there is no FP8 reference with LoRA disabled, so the FP8-only gain and the LoRA overhead on an FP8 base cannot be separated

LoRA application is verified on q/k/v/o_proj and gate/up/down_proj (tpu_sft, taiwan change outputs); jev also targets GDN in_proj_qkv/in_proj_z/out_proj and lm_head, loads and changes outputs; per-module application on the GDN projections was not verified
